review_description: After dropping a solar panel on my veranda, the tradespeople proceeded to both stand on the veranda and cause it to collapse. After promising to get it repaired by their insurance, they stopped answering calls and emails, then blocked or changed their number.Would not ever recommend.

Based on our requirements,  Lumina provided three options at different price points. All options offered were based on quality component's with good warranties. We chose the middle option and booked in an installation date. The installation was done as scheduled and installer's were all very professional and ensured minimal inconvenience to our household during installation. System is performing well and included monitoring is easy to use.
